high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job compiles a CICS BMS (Basic Mapping Support) map named CICSMAP and generates the associated copybook used for screen layout definitions in CICS applications. It executes the BUILDBMS procedure from a utility proclib to perform the assembly/compilation, using AWS.M2 as the high-level qualifier for dataset references. After compilation, it issues a CEMT NEWCOPY command via SDSF to refresh the compiled map program in the active CICS region, making the updated map immediately available without requiring a CICS restart.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The accounting information or job description string passed to the system. Here it provides a descriptive label 'Compile BMS Map' identifying the purpose of the job.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class (input queue) to which the job is submitted. CLASS=A routes the job to job class A, which determines scheduling priority and resource allocation based on installation-defined class definitions.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log (JES message log). MSGCLASS=H routes the system messages and job log to output class H, which controls how and where the job log is printed or held.

parameters.name: MSGLEVEL
parameters.description: Controls the level of JCL and system messages printed in the job log. The first value (1) causes all JCL statements including those from procedures to be printed; the second value (1) causes all system messages including allocation/termination messages to be printed.

parameters.name: REGION
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of memory the job is allowed to use. REGION=0M means the job can use the maximum available region size, effectively removing memory constraints for the entire job.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified when the job completes. &SYSUID is a system symbolic that resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, so that user receives a completion notification message.

parameters.name: TIME
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum CPU time allowed for the entire job in minutes. TIME=1440 sets the limit to 1440 minutes (24 hours), effectively allowing the job to run without a practical CPU time restriction.

job_details.purpose: Copies the BMS map source member CICSMAP from the partitioned dataset into a temporary sequential dataset (&&TEMPM) to be used as input for subsequent assembly steps.
job_details.outputs: SYSUT2: &&TEMPM (temporary dataset, passed to next steps); SYSPRINT: system messages to SYSOUT

job_details.purpose: Assembles the BMS map source using the SYSPARM(MAP) option to generate the physical map object deck, producing a temporary punch dataset (&&MAP) for subsequent link-editing.
job_details.inputs: SYSIN: &&TEMPM (temporary BMS source); SYSLIB: OEM.CICSTS.V05R06M0.CICS.SDFHMAC, SYS1.MACLIB, CEE.SCEEMAC
job_details.outputs: SYSPUNCH: &&MAP (assembled object deck, passed to LKED); SYSUT1, SYSUT2, SYSUT3: temporary work datasets on 3390; SYSPRINT: assembly listing to SYSOUT

job_details.purpose: Link-edits the assembled BMS map object deck into an executable load module, storing the resulting load module in the CARDDEMO load library under member CICSMAP.
job_details.inputs: SYSLIN: &&MAP (assembled object deck from MAP step)
job_details.outputs: SYSLMOD: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB(CICSMAP) (linked load module); SYSUT1: temporary work dataset on 3390; SYSPRINT: link-edit listing to SYSOUT

job_details.purpose: Assembles the BMS map source using the SYSPARM(DSECT) option to generate the symbolic map (DSECT/copybook), writing the output punch deck directly to the CARDDEMO copybook library member CICSMAP and the assembly listing to the LST library.
job_details.inputs: SYSIN: &&TEMPM (temporary BMS source); SYSLIB: OEM.CICSTS.V05R06M0.CICS.SDFHMAC, SYS1.MACLIB, CEE.SCEEMAC
job_details.outputs: SYSPUNCH: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY(CICSMAP) (generated copybook/DSECT); SYSPRINT: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LST(CICSMAP) (assembly listing); SYSUT1, SYSUT2, SYSUT3: temporary work datasets on 3390

job_details.purpose: Replicates the assembly listing from the LST library member CICSMAP to SYSOUT so that the listing is visible in the job output for review.
job_details.outputs: SYSUT2: SYSOUT (listing printed to job output); SYSPRINT: system messages to SYSOUT

job_details.purpose: Deletes the temporary sequential dataset &&TEMPM that was created in the PRINT step and passed through subsequent steps, performing cleanup of temporary resources.
job_details.inputs: TEMPM DD: &&TEMPM (temporary dataset to be deleted)

job_details.purpose: Issues a CICS CEMT SET PROG(CICSMAP) NEWCOPY command via SDSF to instruct CICS to load a fresh copy of the newly compiled CICSMAP program into memory, replacing any previously cached version.
job_details.inputs: ISFIN: inline CEMT command '/MODIFY CICSAWSA,\'CEMT SET PROG(CICSMAP) NEWCOPY\''
job_details.outputs: ISFOUT: SYSOUT (SDSF command output); CMDOUT: SYSOUT (command response output)

data_operations.description: IEBGENER reads the BMS map source member CICSMAP from the partitioned dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.BMS as input (SYSUT1)
IEBGENER writes a copy of the BMS map source to temporary dataset &&TEMPM (SYSUT2), passed to subsequent steps
ASMA90 assembler reads the BMS map source from temporary dataset &&TEMPM (SYSIN) for assembly with SYSPARM(MAP)
ASMA90 assembler reads CICS macro library as part of SYSLIB concatenation for macro resolution during assembly
ASMA90 assembler reads system macro library as part of SYSLIB concatenation for macro resolution during assembly
ASMA90 assembler reads Language Environment macro library as part of SYSLIB concatenation for macro resolution during assembly
ASMA90 assembler writes the assembled object deck (DECK output) to temporary dataset &&MAP (SYSPUNCH), passed to LKED step
Linkage editor HEWL reads the assembled object deck from temporary dataset &&MAP (SYSLIN) as input for link-editing
Linkage editor HEWL writes the linked load module CICSMAP into the load library AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB (SYSLMOD)
ASMA90 assembler reads the BMS map source from temporary dataset &&TEMPM (SYSIN) for DSECT generation with SYSPARM(DSECT)
ASMA90 assembler reads CICS macro library as part of SYSLIB concatenation for macro resolution during DSECT assembly
ASMA90 assembler reads system macro library as part of SYSLIB concatenation for macro resolution during DSECT assembly
ASMA90 assembler reads Language Environment macro library as part of SYSLIB concatenation for macro resolution during DSECT assembly
ASMA90 assembler writes the assembly listing for CICSMAP to the listing partitioned dataset AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LST (SYSPRINT)
ASMA90 assembler writes the generated DSECT copybook for CICSMAP to AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY (SYSPUNCH)
IEBGENER reads the assembly listing member CICSMAP from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LST (SYSUT1) to replicate it to SYSOUT
IEFBR14 deletes the temporary dataset &&TEMPM by specifying DISP=(OLD,DELETE), cleaning up the temporary BMS source copy
SDSF issues CEMT SET PROG(CICSMAP) NEWCOPY command via ISFIN DD to instruct CICS region CICSAWSA to reload the newly linked CICSMAP program
